failuresAndFixes.cause: One 3-minute parent context covered import wait, large result validation/load/export and a second job. Race instrumentation exhausted it in load or the later refusal wait.
failuresAndFixes.fix: Independent 3-minute contexts for import wait, saved-result load and record-budget refusal; import wait canceled after completion. All 54,001-node/exact-byte/record-limit assertions and product budgets preserved.
